_README: Ground truth for the golden-image regression set: what a human reads
off the LCD in each photo. This is the only file in the repo that
knows what the right answer IS — every accuracy number the service
reports is measured against it.
PROVENANCE: transcribed by reading each photo directly. They are
legible at full size (device brand, SYS/DIA/PULSE labels and digits
all clearly visible), but they have NOT yet been double-checked by a
second person. Treat a disagreement between this file and an engine
as 'investigate', not automatically 'the engine is wrong' — verify
the photo first. Mark an entry 'verified': true once a human has
confirmed it.
IMAGES ARE NOT IN GIT. Each id is a directory under debug_images/,
which is gitignored (139 MB of dev output). The suite skips when they
are absent, the same way the model-dependent tests do. To share this
corpus properly it should follow ADR-005: upload to R2 with a sha256
manifest and fetch on demand.
SELECTION IS DELIBERATELY BIASED toward images where crnn and
ssocr_cnn disagreed, because those carry the most information per
label. So per-engine accuracy here is NOT an estimate of field
accuracy — it is a regression baseline. Do not quote these numbers
as 'the accuracy of the service'.
